name: District Disaster Control Room & Flood Staging Camp
description: 24x7 command post coordinating relief personnel and disaster response teams.
official_helpline_info: Contact official district helpline via national emergency number 112 or State Disaster Toll-Free 1077.

name: Swaroop Rani Nehru Hospital Emergency & Trauma Center
description: Tertiary trauma center equipped for triage and emergency surgical stabilization.
official_helpline_info: Contact official hospital emergency reception or national ambulance service 108 / 112.

name: King George's Medical University Trauma Center
description: Level-1 emergency trauma and mass-casualty disaster response facility.
official_helpline_info: Dial emergency ambulance 108 or KGMU emergency triage hotline via 112.

name: Gomti Barrage Flood Relief Staging Camp
description: Municipal flood response shelter equipped with mobile water purification units and dry rations.
official_helpline_info: Shelter ingress managed under District Magistrate orders. Consult municipal sirens.

name: BHU Sir Sunderlal Hospital Trauma Center
description: Regional multi-specialty disaster medical center with intensive burn and shock trauma wards.
official_helpline_info: Contact BHU trauma reception or dial national emergency 112.

name: Assi Ghat Jal Police Rescue Staging Post
description: Riverine rescue depot with motorized inflatable craft, life rafts, and emergency flotation gear.
official_helpline_info: Water rescue dispatch strictly coordinated by Varanasi District Control Room.

name: AIIMS Apex Trauma Center
description: National apex disaster trauma facility with disaster triage wings and blood bank supplies.
location_name: Ring Road, Safdarjung Enclave, New Delhi
official_helpline_info: Dial emergency ambulance 102/108 or national emergency line 112.

name: Yamuna Bazar Community Flood Shelter
description: Designated municipal relief center with tents, drinking water tanks, and sanitation kits.
location_name: Kashmere Gate / Yamuna Bazar, New Delhi
official_helpline_info: Evacuation camp entry coordinated by Delhi Disaster Management Authority.
